newsitem.title: USA: Great Western adopts by-law amendments.
newsitem.headline: Great Western adopts by-law amendments.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp, target of a takeover bid by H.F. Ahmanson and Co, said Friday that its board of directors adopted an amendment to the company's by-laws establishing procedures for the setting of a record date for consent solicitations.

The amendment, meant to take effect immediately, requires any stockholder of Great Western seeking to have a record date set for a consent solicitation to deliver written notice to Great Western requesting a record date be established by Great Western's board of directors, the company said.
The board will then be required, within 10 days after the date such request is received, to adopt a resolution fixing a record date for the consent solicitation.
H.F. Ahmanson said earlier this week it intended to solicit written consents from the stockholders of Great Western with respect to two proposals.
The by-law amendment is designed to establish an orderly process for the Ahmanson consent solicitation, the company said.
